verdict.rationale: A data platform could plausibly ship scheduled or background jobs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no product-provided automation, scheduler, or autonomous background execution. Reindexing is explicitly a manual `optimize()` call, and agent branch experiments are user- or agent-driven workflows the product does not run autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
